What we build

Hardscape and turf, start to finish

From the first stake and spray paint to the final sweep. Grading, base, and finish are all handled by the same crew.

Travertine

Natural stone that stays cooler underfoot in the Arizona sun. Our go-to for patios and pool decks.

  • Patios & pool decks
  • Walkways & side yards
  • French pattern or straight lay

Concrete

Poured and finished slabs that hold up to heat, trucks and monsoon season.

  • Patio slabs & extensions
  • Driveways & pads
  • Sidewalks & borders

Pavers

Interlocking pavers on a compacted base, so they stay level and easy to repair.

  • Driveways & walkways
  • Fire pit & seating areas
  • Edging & borders

Turf

Artificial grass that stays green year-round with no mowing and a lower water bill.

  • Front & back lawns
  • Pet & play areas
  • Putting greens

Also: desert landscaping, rock and gravel, grading and clean-outs, plants, and full front-yard or backyard makeovers.

Common questions

Are estimates really free?

Yes. We come out, measure, and give you a price at no cost and with no obligation.

Travertine or pavers: which should I pick?

Travertine stays cooler barefoot and looks more natural, so it's great around pools. Pavers come in more colors and shapes and suit driveways well. We'll show you both on the estimate.

How long does a typical job take?

Most patios, walkways and turf installs take a few days. Bigger backyard makeovers take longer. You'll get a timeline with your quote.

Do you remove the old grass, rock or concrete?

Yes. Tear-out, haul-off and grading can all be included in your quote.
